fields.headline: TEXAS SCRAMBLE.
fields.body: The format for the corporate day, the charity day and the pair who have not played since last year.

fields.headline: BEST POSITION, EVERY SHOT.
fields.body: Both partners play every shot from the best position of the previous one, until the ball is holed. Nobody has a bad hole on their own.

fields.headline: 35 AND 15.
fields.body: The side plays off 35% of the lower course handicap plus 15% of the higher, shots off the difference. Change the percentages if your society uses others.

fields.headline: YOUR PERCENTAGES.
fields.body: The allowances sit on the session. Change them and the handicaps re-derive on the existing draw without reshuffling the pairings.

fields.headline:
